observations: Two Dial was run for a while and became partly intelligible in use.
The requested improvement is wider/deeper music generation, more modes/instruments and cleaner menus/options—not replacement of the two-dial relation core.
LIVE was fun/useful but its purpose needed to become legible; it should not monopolize the family.
Scale Lens felt operationally strange inside the Fold/Bloom sibling grid.
The earlier scale-in-Fold/Bloom interaction was remembered as promising and worth recovering as a mode.
